newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: INSIGHT-Australian gold index continues in range.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-Australian gold index continues in range.

text.p: --------------Analysis by Daniel Fock - June 6)-------------
*Index sideways within range 1,530 to 1,610.
*Indicators mixed.
*Traders caution as index moves towards bottom of range.
*Australian gold index closed at 1,549.4 on Thursday
The Australian Gold Index is still range trading within the established consolidation zone 1,530 to 1,610.
Indicators are mixed so traders are likely to continue to trade the range and the breaks.
Short term technicals are mixed but turning bearish. The averages are bearish.
Leading indicators are all turning lower after reaching midpoint levels.
This is significant in that the bulls made little impression over the week. Support has continued to hold.
Short term resistance persists at 1,575 and bulls will be anxious for this to break.
In the medium term, the index is still range trading - the bulls would say consolidating or building a base.
The index is at the bottom of the bear channel and support is holding. So as with the short term, traders are likely to trade the range and the breaks.
Medium term technicals are bearish and very oversold.
Averages are bearish. Leading indicators continue oversold and are trading sideways.
While support holds, trades are likely to focus on higher Fibonacci retracements of 1,710, 1,766, and 1,821.
In the longer term, the index continues lower within its bear corridor but is above last month's low.
Bears continue to focus on the head and shoulders formation, but with the oversold nature of the index they too will be cautious and move trailling stops closer to current levels.
There is a possible re-test of the neckline at 1,665/70.
Longer term technicals are bearish and oversold. Averages remain bearish while leading indicators are losing bearish momentum, but are still lower.
The index will need to rally above 1,665/70 to concern the long term bears.
The index continues bouncing from support around 1,530, forming what could be a rounding bottom or saucer support from which it can rally.
Interim resistance at 1,575 will need a break to entice buying.
The index is still in a short term consolidation/congestion pattern, within the bear channels of all time frames.
Resistance is at 1,575 and 1,610.
Leading indicators are mixed to sideways, so expect more range trading.
Seasoned traders are likely to remain cautious but the trend is down in all time frames.
They will continue to trade the range and the trend and change strategies when there is confirmation of such a change.
(Daniel Fock is a member of the Australian Technical Analysts Association. Views are his own.)
-- Sydney newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
